evidence_status: 2022 plant rating and annual outputs documented; 2020 electricity prices observed; efficiency and gas buffer hypothetical, entire dispatch simulated
methodological_note: Perfect-foresight electricity-only ceiling; no hourly measured gas production, gas storage or CHP heat service. 2022 annual mean assumed constant at 2020 SE3 day-ahead prices. No gas export, CHP minimum load, starts, ramping, heat demand, parasitic electric use or imbalance cost.
observed_plant_reference: Åberg (2024) SLU thesis, Lövsta 2022 annual electricity 3002.6 MWh, heat 2939.5 MWh and 499 kW generator rating
